title: Supplier access exception SAX-0417 (fictional)
text: Northwind Analytics requested read access to the reporting warehouse on 2026-09-02. Northwind Analytics completed the vendor security assessment on 2026-09-15. Dana Reyes approved the exception on 2026-09-16. Access is limited to the reporting warehouse for ninety days. Because the assessment was completed and the exception was approved with a time limit, the exception can proceed to finalisation.
